WITH
-- Filter transactions paid in EUR and aggregate consumption by CustomerID and year
consumption_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        strftime('%Y', t.Date) AS Year,
        t.CustomerID,
        SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS Consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.Date) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, t.CustomerID, Year
),
-- Aggregate consumption by segment and year
segment_year_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        Year,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM consumption_by_year
    GROUP BY Segment, Year
),
-- Calculate increase and percentage increase per segment
segment_increase AS (
    SELECT
        s2013.Segment,
        s2013.TotalConsumption AS Consumption2013,
        COALESCE(s2013.TotalConsumption - s2012.TotalConsumption, s2013.TotalConsumption) AS Increase,
        CASE 
            WHEN s2013.TotalConsumption = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((s2013.TotalConsumption - COALESCE(s2012.TotalConsumption, 0)) / s2013.TotalConsumption) * 100
        END AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM segment_year_consumption s2013
    LEFT JOIN segment_year_consumption s2012
        ON s2013.Segment = s2012.Segment AND s2012.Year = '2012'
    WHERE s2013.Year = '2013'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM segment_increase ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC LIMIT 1) AS SegmentWithBiggestIncrease,
    (SELECT PercentageIncrease FROM segment_increase ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC LIMIT 1) AS BiggestPercentageIncrease,
    (SELECT Segment FROM segment_increase ORDER BY PercentageIncrease ASC LIMIT 1) AS SegmentWithLowestIncrease,
    (SELECT PercentageIncrease FROM segment_increase ORDER BY PercentageIncrease ASC LIMIT 1) AS LowestPercentageIncrease

WITH cons_2012_2013 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        substr(y.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, Year
),
cons_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2013
    FROM cons_2012_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
cons_change AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        Cons2013,
        Cons2012,
        (Cons2013 - Cons2012) AS IncreaseOrDecrease,
        CASE WHEN Cons2013 != 0 THEN ((Cons2013 - Cons2012) * 100.0 / Cons2013) ELSE NULL END AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM cons_pivot
)
SELECT 
    'Biggest Increase' AS Type,
    Segment,
    PercentageIncrease
FROM cons_change
WHERE PercentageIncrease = (SELECT MAX(PercentageIncrease) FROM cons_change)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Lowest Increase' AS Type,
    Segment,
    PercentageIncrease
FROM cons_change
WHERE PercentageIncrease = (SELECT MIN(PercentageIncrease) FROM cons_change)

        c.Segment,
        substr(y.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption

    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, Year
),
diffs AS (
    SELECT
        c2013.Segment,
        c2013.TotalConsumption AS Consumption2013,
        c2013.TotalConsumption - COALESCE(c2012.TotalConsumption, 0) AS IncreaseOrDecrease,

        (SELECT * FROM consumption_2012_2013 WHERE Year = '2013') c2013
    LEFT JOIN 
        (SELECT * FROM consumption_2012_2013 WHERE Year = '2012') c2012
    ON c2013.Segment = c2012.Segment
)

    SELECT 
        ym.CustomerID,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
lam_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_lam_customers,
        SUM(CASE WHEN total_consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS customers_above_46_73

)

FROM lam_counts

WITH SME_Customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Currency
    FROM customers
    WHERE Segment = 'SME'
),
SME_Transactions AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID, c.Currency, SUM(t.Price * t.Amount) AS TotalPayment
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN SME_Customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
),
Currency_Sums AS (
    SELECT Currency, SUM(TotalPayment) AS TotalPayment
    FROM SME_Transactions
    GROUP BY Currency
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE((SELECT TotalPayment FROM Currency_Sums WHERE Currency = 'CZK'), 0) > COALESCE((SELECT TotalPayment FROM Currency_Sums WHERE Currency = 'EUR'), 0)
        THEN 'True'
        ELSE 'False'
    END AS More_SMEs_pay_in_CZK,
    COALESCE((SELECT TotalPayment FROM Currency_Sums WHERE Currency = 'CZK'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT TotalPayment FROM Currency_Sums WHERE Currency = 'EUR'), 0) AS Difference

WITH RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        `School Name`,
        `Free Meal Count (K-12)`,
        `Enrollment (K-12)`,
        CASE 
            WHEN `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 THEN `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`
            ELSE NULL
        END AS EligibleFreeRate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC) AS rn
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    `School Name`,
    EligibleFreeRate
FROM RankedSchools
WHERE rn IN (10, 11)

WITH GermanDrivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename || ' ' || surname AS fullName
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'German'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
),
AvgPitStopDuration AS (
    SELECT p.driverId, AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(p.duration, 1, LENGTH(p.duration)-1) AS REAL)) AS avgDuration
    FROM pitStops p
    JOIN GermanDrivers gd ON p.driverId = gd.driverId
    WHERE p.duration IS NOT NULL AND p.duration != ''
    GROUP BY p.driverId
)
SELECT gd.fullName, apd.avgDuration
FROM AvgPitStopDuration apd
JOIN GermanDrivers gd ON apd.driverId = gd.driverId
ORDER BY apd.avgDuration ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH AbnormalUA AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0)
       OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5)
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Male_to_Female_Ratio
FROM AbnormalUA

WITH Top3Youngest AS (
    SELECT code, dob
    FROM drivers
    WHERE code IS NOT NULL AND code != ''
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
NetherlandicCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality IN ('Dutch', 'Netherlandic')
      AND code IN (SELECT code FROM Top3Youngest)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(code, ', ') FROM Top3Youngest) AS top3_codes,
    (SELECT count FROM NetherlandicCount) AS netherlandic_count

WITH Top3Youngest AS (
    SELECT driverId, code, dob
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    GROUP_CONCAT(code, ', ') AS top3_codes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nationality = 'Dutch' OR nationality = 'Netherlandic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS netherlandic_count
FROM Top3Youngest t
JOIN drivers d ON t.driverId = d.driverId

WITH Top3Youngest AS (
    SELECT code
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(code, ', ') FROM Top3Youngest) AS top3_codes,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE code IN (SELECT code FROM Top3Youngest) AND nationality = 'Dutch') AS netherlandic_count

WITH youngest_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, code, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', dob)) AS age
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY age ASC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(code, ', ') FROM youngest_drivers) AS top_3_youngest_driver_codes,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM youngest_drivers d JOIN drivers dr ON d.driverId = dr.driverId WHERE dr.nationality = 'Dutch' OR dr.nationality = 'Netherlandic') AS netherlandic_count

WITH youngest_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, code, (julianday('now') - julianday(dob)) / 365.25 AS age_years
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY age_years ASC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    GROUP_CONCAT(code, ', ') AS top_3_youngest_driver_codes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nationality = 'Dutch' OR nationality = 'Netherlandic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS netherlandic_count
FROM youngest_drivers yd
JOIN drivers d ON yd.driverId = d.driverId

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN ex.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / 
    SUM(ex.cost) AS percentage_cost_yearly_kickoff
FROM expense ex
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN ex.cost ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(ex.cost), 0), 2
    ) AS yearly_kickoff_cost_percentage
FROM expense ex

JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN ex.cost ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(ex.cost), 0), 2
    ) AS percentage_cost_yearly_kickoff
FROM expense ex
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN ex.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / SUM(ex.cost) AS percentage
FROM expense ex
JOIN budget b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

WITH yearly_kickoff_cost AS (
    SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
    WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
),
total_cost AS (
    SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM expense
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total_cost.total_cost = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (yearly_kickoff_cost.total_cost * 100.0) / total_cost.total_cost
    END AS percentage_cost_for_yearly_kickoff
FROM yearly_kickoff_cost, total_cost

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) 
        / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.client_id)
           FROM client c2
           JOIN disp d2 ON c2.client_id = d2.client_id
           JOIN account a2 ON d2.account_id = a2.account_id
           WHERE a2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), 2) AS male_weekly_statement_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M' 
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FILTER (WHERE c.gender = 'M') / 
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 2
    ) AS male_weekly_statement_percentage

WITH HamiltonResults AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year, res.position
    FROM results res
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.year >= 2010
),
FirstCircuit AS (
    SELECT circuitId
    FROM races
    WHERE year >= 2010
    GROUP BY circuitId
    ORDER BY MIN(date) ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
HamiltonFirstCircuitResults AS (
    SELECT hr.position
    FROM HamiltonResults hr
    JOIN races r ON hr.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN FirstCircuit fc ON r.circuitId = fc.circuitId
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN position > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)
    , 2) AS percentage_not_first_position
FROM HamiltonFirstCircuitResults

WITH Hamilton_Races AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.round
    FROM results res
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.year >= 2010
),
First_Track_Rounds AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(round) AS first_round
    FROM races
    WHERE year >= 2010
    GROUP BY year

Hamilton_Race_With_First_Track AS (
    SELECT hr.raceId, r.year, r.round, ftr.first_round

WITH CommunityPosts AS (
    SELECT p.Id
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'
),
CommunityPostsCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM CommunityPosts
),
CommunityRPostsCount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS r_count
    FROM CommunityPosts cp
    JOIN posts p ON cp.Id = p.Id
    WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE CAST(r_count AS FLOAT) / total 
    END AS percentage
FROM CommunityPostsCount, CommunityRPostsCount

WITH total_heroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(id) AS total_count
    FROM superhero
),
bad_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.id, p.publisher_name
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
    LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
),
bad_heroes_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_count
    FROM bad_heroes
),
marvel_bad_heroes_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS marvel_bad_count
    FROM bad_heroes
    WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((bad_heroes_count.bad_count * 100.0) / total_heroes.total_count, 2) AS percentage_bad_heroes,
    marvel_bad_heroes_count.marvel_bad_count AS marvel_bad_heroes
FROM total_heroes, bad_heroes_count, marvel_bad_heroes_count

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.id), 2) AS percentage_bad_alignment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT 
    f.`School Name`,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 THEN f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
        ELSE NULL
    END AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '66'
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 20
ORDER BY q.q1 DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH q1_times AS (
    SELECT driverId, q1
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceId = 20
      AND q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND q1 != ''
),
max_q1 AS (
    SELECT MAX(q1) AS max_q1_time
    FROM q1_times
)
SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying q
JOIN dRivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN max_q1 m ON q.q1 = m.max_q1_time
WHERE q.raceId = 20
ORDER BY d.driverRef

    WHERE A3 = 'South Bohemia'

    (strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS Age_at_First_Date
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC, L.Date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM 
    Player p
JOIN 
    Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE 
    pa.sprint_speed >= 97
    AND substr(pa.date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015'
GROUP BY 
    p.player_api_id

WITH K8_Magnet_Schools AS (
    SELECT 
        frpm.CDSCode,
        frpm.`School Name`,
        frpm.`County Name`,
        frpm.`District Name`,
        frpm.`School Type`,
        frpm.`NSLP Provision Status`,
        frpm.`Low Grade`,
        frpm.`High Grade`,
        schools.City,
        schools.Magnet
    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE schools.Magnet = 1
      AND (
          (frpm.`Low Grade` = 'K' OR frpm.`Low Grade` = 'Kindergarten')
          AND (frpm.`High Grade` = '8' OR frpm.`High Grade` = '8th')
      )
),
Multiple_Provision_Count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS MultipleProvisionCount
    FROM K8_Magnet_Schools
    WHERE `NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
),
City_School_Count AS (
    SELECT 
        City,
        COUNT(*) AS SchoolCount
    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE (frpm.`Low Grade` = 'K' OR frpm.`Low Grade` = 'Kindergarten')
      AND (frpm.`High Grade` = '8' OR frpm.`High Grade` = '8th')
    GROUP BY City
),
City_Count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT City) AS CityCount
    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE (frpm.`Low Grade` = 'K' OR frpm.`Low Grade` = 'Kindergarten')
      AND (frpm.`High Grade` = '8' OR frpm.`High Grade` = '8th')
)

SELECT 
    (SELECT MultipleProvisionCount FROM Multiple_Provision_Count) AS Magnet_K8_MultipleProvisionSchools,
    (SELECT CityCount FROM City_Count) AS Cities_Offering_K8,
    City,
    SchoolCount
FROM City_School_Count
ORDER BY City

    AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Admin3_FullName

WHERE CDSCode = (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumGE1500 = (
        SELECT MAX(NumGE1500)
        FROM satscores
    )
)

WITH max_numge1500 AS (
    SELECT cds, NumGE1500
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

    COALESCE(s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1, '') AS Admin1_FullName,

    WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL

top_school AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode

    JOIN max_sat m ON s.cds = m.cds AND s.NumGE1500 = m.max_numge1500

    COALESCE(AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1, '') AS Admin1_FullName,

WITH FirstRace AS (
    SELECT 
        d.driverId,
        MIN(r.date) AS first_race_date
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY d.driverId
),
YoungestDriver AS (
    SELECT 
        driverId,
        forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name,
        nationality,
        dob
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    yd.full_name,
    yd.nationality,
    r.name AS first_race_name
FROM YoungestDriver yd
JOIN FirstRace fr ON yd.driverId = fr.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.date = fr.first_race_date AND r.raceId IN (
    SELECT raceId FROM results WHERE driverId = yd.driverId
)
ORDER BY r.date
LIMIT 1

WITH youngest_driver AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name, nationality, dob
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_race AS (
    SELECT r.name AS race_name, r.date
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN youngest_driver yd ON res.driverId = yd.driverId
    ORDER BY r.date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT yd.full_name, yd.nationality, fr.race_name
FROM youngest_driver yd
CROSS JOIN first_race fr
